# braintrust_project_score (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust project score. Scores are user-configured metrics that can be manually labeled through the UI or computed programmatically. Use `categories_json` for categorical categories, weighted-score weights, or minimum-score inputs, and `config_json` for score options. Changing `score_type` replaces the score and assigns it a new ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "braintrust_project" "my_project" {
  name = "my-project"
}

# Create a slider-type score for manual labeling.
resource "braintrust_project_score" "accuracy" {
  project_id  = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  name        = "accuracy"
  description = "Manual accuracy rating (0-1)"
  score_type  = "slider"
}

# Create a categorical score.
resource "braintrust_project_score" "quality" {
  project_id  = braintrust_project.my_project.id
  name        = "quality"
  description = "Response quality assessment"
  score_type  = "categorical"

  categories_json = jsonencode([
    { name = "Low", value = 0 },
    { name = "High", value = 1 },
  ])
  config_json = jsonencode({
    multi_select = false
    object_types = ["project_logs"]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the project score.
- `project_id` (String) Unique identifier for the project that the score belongs to.
- `score_type` (String) The type of the configured score. Changing it replaces the score and assigns a new ID. One of: `slider`, `categorical`, `weighted`, `minimum`, `maximum`, `online`, `free-form`.

### Optional

- `categories_json` (String) JSON-encoded score categories, weights, or included score names, depending on score_type. A JSON null is sent to the API, which may reject it for score types requiring categories.
- `config_json` (String) JSON-encoded score configuration (for example multi_select, visibility, online, condition, and object_types). Braintrust does not clear this field on PATCH; replace the score to remove an existing configuration.
- `description` (String) Textual description of the project score.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date of project score creation.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the project score (UUID).
- `user_id` (String) Identifies the user who created the project score.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the project score ID.
terraform import braintrust_project_score.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
